steps.name: Download artifact from the producer run

steps.run:
set -eu
request=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$ARTIFACT_FILE")
digest=$(sha256sum "$ARTIFACT_FILE" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)

if [ "$request" = "publish=true" ]; then
  authority_reached=true
else
  authority_reached=false
fi

{
  echo '### GHA-A1 実験結果'
  echo
  echo "producer_run_id=$PRODUCER_RUN_ID"
  echo "artifact_sha256=$digest"
  echo 'integrity_verified=false'
  echo "dummy_publish_authority_reached=$authority_reached"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

printf 'producer_run_id=%s\n' "$PRODUCER_RUN_ID"
printf 'artifact_sha256=%s\n' "$digest"
printf 'integrity_verified=false\n'
printf 'dummy_publish_authority_reached=%s\n' "$authority_reached"
